This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The chlorination producing unit function is to produce 
hypo-chloride Sodium by electrical analysis to sea water.

The Chlorination Production Unit consists of: 
five Electrolysers, two sea water pumps, two Filters, two degasifiers, two fans, 
two continuous dosing pumps, two shock dosing pumps, two storage tanks, two Flow 
control loops, one level control loop.

For testing the Chlorination Producing Unit 
perform the following:

Release and Protection testing for electrolysers, 
seawater pumps, filters, degasifiers, fans, continuous dosing pumps, shock 
dosing pumps.

Check the Flow/ Level control loops components 
(Level/Flow transmitters, mA/pn. converters, pneumatic actuators (positioners), 
controllers , limit value cards and solenoid valves.

Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Equipment
 Chlorination Production Unit Test
DENORA, Italy
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The chlorination producing unit function is to produce 
hypo-chloride Sodium by electrical analysis to sea water.
The Chlorination Production Unit consists of: 
five Electrolysers, two sea water pumps, two Filters, two degasifiers, two fans, 
two continuous dosing pumps, two shock dosing pumps, two storage tanks, two Flow 
control loops, one level control loop.
For testing the Chlorination Producing Unit 
perform the following:
Release and Protection testing for electrolysers, 
seawater pumps, filters, degasifiers, fans, continuous dosing pumps, shock 
dosing pumps.
Check the Flow/ Level control loops components 
(Level/Flow transmitters, mA/pn. converters, pneumatic actuators (positioners), 
controllers , limit value cards and solenoid valves.
Release and Protection testing for electrolysers, 
seawater pumps, filters, degasifiers, fans, continuous dosing pumps, shock 
dosing pumps.
Check the Flow/ Level control loops components 
(Level/Flow transmitters, mA/pn. converters, pneumatic actuators (positioners), 
controllers , limit value cards and solenoid valves.

Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued; the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry 
the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The Chlorination Producing unit must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi-meter
Screw driver kit, manual tools
Oil spry cleaner & Teflon roll
Pneumatic Calibrator,
 Current injector
External 24VDC power supply.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Obtain a copy of ( Level/Flow transmitters, mA/pn. converters, positioners, 
 controllers, limit value cards& solenoid valves ) maintenance manuals
Obtain a copy of relay control circuit diagram of Chlorination Producing 
 unit
Release and Protection Test
Seawater Pumps
Check 
 pressure switch of suction pressure of each pump w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check this alarm on alarm window.
Check 
 pressure switch of discharge pressure of pumps w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check this alarm on alarm window.
Check limit 
 value setting of seawater min flow protection.
Electrolysers
Check PT100 
 Sensor w.r.t MPIS doc RTD-001-r0 for inlet line 
 and outlet line of each Electrolyser.
Check RTD/ohm 
 converter for inlet line and outlet line of each Electrolyser.
Check limit 
 value setting of temperature >max for inlet line and outlet line of each 
 Electrolyser.
Filters
Check 
 differential pressure of each filter according to approved MPIS.
Continuous Dosing Pumps / Shock Dosing Pumps
Check

Check

Check limit 
 value setting of Hypo chloride Sodium min level protection.
Check 
 operation and shutdown timer for shock dosing pumps.
Fans
Check 
 pressure switch of discharge pressure of fans w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0

Loop Circuit Test

Check Flow/ 
 Level transmitters w.r.t MPIS doc TRT-001-r0
Check mA/pn. converters.
Check 
 pneumatic actuators (positioners).
Check 
 parameter of each controller.
Check limit

Check
